signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Establish a prioritized go-to-market product roadmap, agreed to by Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and executive leadership, with a clear intake and prioritization process the…
Simplify the go-to-market technology stack by reducing redundant tools and manual handoffs, without disrupting revenue-critical workflows.
Deliver major platform milestones with Engineering on agreed timelines, with clear success criteria for each.
Set baselines early, then show measurable gains in time saved, cycle time, data quality, and user adoption.
Build trusted partnerships with senior GTM leaders, where hard trade-off conversations lead to better decisions.
Put a thesis on record for what the next generation of the suite is, argued in working software customers have touched, and won cross-functional and leadership support for it.
Built the first version of at least two new products from that thesis yourself, then ran a pod of four or fewer from prototype to GA with no dedicated project management.
Those products live in customer environments, with measurable revenue, adoption, or retention impact.
Made the current suite smaller. At least one existing legacy solution retired or folded into its successor, without customer churn.
You will accomplish these outcomes through the following responsibilities:
